interfaceScale.label: Interface scale
interfaceScale.description: Resize text, buttons, and panels. Saved in this browser or app on this device.

accessDenied.title: Microphone access denied
accessDenied.description: Grant microphone permission to choose an input device.

permissionPrompt.description: Microphone permission needed to list and choose an input device.

meter.hint: The level meter activates once you join a voice channel.

device.unsupported: This browser doesn't support choosing an output device. Audio plays to the system default.

permissionPrompt.description: Grant microphone permission to list output devices (browsers gate output names behind microphone access).

accessDenied.title: Camera access denied
accessDenied.description: Grant camera permission to choose a camera.

blocked.browser: Camera blocked at browser level. Click the camera icon in your browser's address bar, reset the permission, then click Try again.
blocked.mac: Grant camera access in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Camera, then restart the app.
blocked.windows: Grant camera access in Settings → Privacy & Security → Camera, then restart the app.
blocked.other: Camera permission was denied. Reset it in your browser/Chromium prompt and try again.

permissionPrompt.description: Camera permission needed to choose a camera and preview.

previewError.inUse: Camera is in use by another application.

background.label: Background

own.missing: Your picture is no longer on this device. Until you add one, your room is blurred.

problem.notAnImage: This browser cannot open that file as a picture.
problem.notKept: This browser would not keep the picture. A private window often can't.

background.failed: The background could not start on this device.
background.strained: This device is struggling to keep up. Soft blur, or no background, keeps your picture smooth.
background.private: Backgrounds are made on this device. Your picture stays here and is never uploaded.

messageSound.label: Play sound for every message
messageSound.description: Off (default): only DMs and messages that mention you. On: every channel.

showOnSwitch.label: Show floating window during calls
showOnSwitch.description: While you are in a voice channel or call and look at something else, a small window keeps the call in view.

noiseSuppression.label: AI Noise Suppression
noiseSuppression.description: ML-based noise removal (RNNoise). Filters keyboard, fans and background noise.

echoCancellation.label: Echo Cancellation
echoCancellation.description: Cancels echo from your speakers feeding back into the mic. Always on for voice channels and calls.

autoGain.label: Auto Gain Control
autoGain.description: Auto-adjusts mic volume. Can cause voice ducking during streams.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: The colours of the app's surfaces. Kept on this device.

accent.title: Accent colour
accent.description: The colour of buttons and highlights. Without one of your own, the colour this server chose is used.

problem.too_light: Too light: white text on buttons would be hard to read.
problem.too_dark: Too dark: it would disappear on the dark panels.

textSize.label: Chat text size
textSize.description: How large message text is drawn in chats.

reduceMotion.label: Reduce motion
reduceMotion.description: Switches off animations such as sliding panels. Animated pictures keep moving.

light.label: Ambient light
light.description: A soft light in the colour of the place you are in.

corners.label: Corners
corners.description: How square or round buttons, cards and fields are.

avatars.label: Profile pictures
avatars.description: The shape every profile picture is cut to.

sidebar.label: Sidebar width
sidebar.description: How wide the list of channels and conversations is.

style.label: Style
style.description: How messages are laid out in every chat.

bubbles.label: Bubbles
bubbles.description: Each message on a card; yours on the right.

rows.label: Rows
rows.description: Picture, name and text in open rows.

lines.label: Log
lines.description: Time, name and text on a single line.

density.label: Spacing
density.description: How much room there is between messages.

clock.label: Clock
clock.description: How times of day are written.

underlineLinks.label: Underline links
underlineLinks.description: Links are underlined, not only coloured.

typeface.title: Typography
typeface.label: Typeface
typeface.description: The type the whole app is set in. Chinese text always uses the system's.

contrast.label: Higher contrast
contrast.description: Brighter secondary text and clearer edges.

status.label: Colour-blind friendly status
status.description: Online, idle and busy use colours that are easy to tell apart.

detached.notice: This account is detached from its home instance.
detached.explanation: {{homeInstance}} was reset or is no longer available, so this account now operates locally on this instance. Your profile and password are managed here.
detached.reattachHint: As {{username}} on {{homeInstance}}, you can re-link this account. Profile and presence will sync from there again.

image.animationTooLarge: Animated pictures can be at most {{max}} MB. Choose a smaller one.

theme.label: Profile theme
theme.hint: Two colours that paint your banner and tint your profile card.
theme.preview: How your profile card will look

links.label: Links
links.hint: Up to {{max}} web addresses on your profile card, each with an optional label.
links.invalid: Enter a web address that starts with https:// or http://, at most {{max}} characters long.

layout.label: Card layout
layout.hint: How the top of your profile card is arranged.

status.label: Status
status.homeUnavailable: Your status is kept on {{host}}. Connect to {{host}} to change it.

password.tooShort: New password must be at least {{min}} characters

danger.description: Once you delete your account, there is no going back. Your messages will remain but be attributed to "Deleted User".

warning.headline: This will permanently delete your account.
warning.spaces: All space memberships will be removed
warning.friends: All friend connections will be removed
warning.dms: All DM memberships will be removed
warning.messages: Your messages will remain but be attributed to "Deleted User"

ownedSpaces.prompt_one: You own {{count}} space. Handle each before continuing:
ownedSpaces.prompt_other: You own {{count}} spaces. Handle each before continuing:

confirm.permanent: This action is permanent and cannot be undone.

federation.removing: Removing your account from connected instances…

dataExport.title: A copy of your data
dataExport.description: Everything this server holds about your account: your profile, what you wrote, your files. It takes a moment to prepare and stays ready for a week.
dataExport.pending: Your copy is being prepared. You can close this; it will be here when you come back.
dataExport.failed: The copy could not be made. Please try again.

storage.title: Your files
storage.description: What you sent counts here, each file once, also when you forwarded it. Deleting the messages it is in makes room again.

username.hint: {{min}} to {{max}} small letters, digits or underscores.
username.warning: You sign in with the new name from then on. You can change it again after {{days}} days, and your old name stays reserved for that long, so nobody can pose as you.
username.nextChange: You can change it again on {{date}}.
username.homeOnly: This name is set on the server your account comes from.
username.connected: This account is connected to other servers, which know it by this name, so it cannot be changed for now.

activity.label: Share Activity Status
activity.description: Allow others to see what you're up to, like games you're playing or music you're listening to.

blocked.description: People you block cannot message you or send you friend requests, and their messages in shared spaces and groups are hidden. They are not told.
blocked.loadFailed: Could not load your blocked people.

dm.label: Who can start a conversation with you
dm.description: Conversations you already have stay open. To end one, block the person.

options.friendsAndSpaces: Friends and people in a space with you

requests.label: Who can send you friend requests
requests.description: Anyone else does not find you when searching by name.

options.sharedSpaces: People in a space with you

streamer.title: Streamer mode
streamer.description: Keeps what is personal off your screen while you stream it or share it. It is this device's setting.
streamer.automaticDescription: When OBS, Streamlabs or XSplit starts, and off again when it closes, unless you turned it off yourself.
streamer.automaticDesktopOnly: In the desktop app it can turn on by itself when OBS, Streamlabs or XSplit starts.
streamer.hidesTitle: While it is on, Tavvit hides

hides.invites: Invite links and codes (copying them still works)
hides.sessions: Where your sessions are signed in

portal.description: On Wayland, the desktop manages all Tavvit shortcuts. Assign, change or remove keys in the system's keyboard shortcut settings, under Tavvit. Local browser/X11 bindings are not used here.
portal.idle: Preparing first-time registration of all available actions.
portal.pending: Connecting to the desktop portal. If a system dialog appears, choose shortcuts for the actions you want to use.
portal.ready: Tavvit is registered. Open your system's keyboard shortcut settings to change or remove assignments. The list below is read-only and refreshes when you return to Tavvit.
portal.unavailable: The portal is unavailable, permission was denied, or the session ended. A Global Shortcuts portal backend is required. Local bindings are disabled on Wayland.

note.webOnly: Shortcuts work while this tab is focused. For global shortcuts that work in other apps, use the desktop app.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Permission Required
accessibility.description: Tavvit needs Accessibility permission for global shortcuts to work outside the app.

hookError.title: Global Shortcuts Unavailable
hookError.description: Failed to start input listener. On Linux, your user may need to be in the input group.

typingKey.title: This shortcut needs Ctrl or the system key
typingKey.description: Letters, digits, punctuation, the number pad, Space, Enter, Tab and Backspace only work together with Ctrl or the system key, and not with Alt as well: with Alt, many keyboards type a character. On their own, the app would hear what you type in other programs, so it does not listen for them. Function keys, mouse buttons and keys like Caps Lock work alone.

openAtLogin.label: Start at boot
openAtLogin.description: Automatically launch Tavvit when you log in

startMinimized.label: Start minimized
startMinimized.description: Start hidden in the system tray instead of showing the window

updates.upToDate: You are on the latest version
updates.idle: Check for new versions of the desktop app
updates.external: Updates are installed through your Flatpak software manager
updates.manualNote: This build cannot install updates itself, so new versions are downloaded from this server's download page and installed by hand.
updates.externalNote: Flatpak applies updates atomically outside the app. Use your software manager or the flatpak update command to update Tavvit.
updates.autoNote: Updates download and install by themselves: Tavvit restarts when it is in the tray or nobody has used the computer for a few minutes, never during a call.

emoji.title: Emoji
emoji.intro: A shared library of pictures for everyone on this server. Use them in any chat: type :name: or pick one from the emoji menu.

add.title: Add an emoji
add.hint: PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, up to {{max}} MB. It is shrunk to fit 128 pixels, and an animated GIF keeps moving.
add.name: Name
add.tooLarge: That file is larger than {{max}} MB.
add.unreadable: That file could not be read.

library.title: Library
library.empty: No emoji yet. Add the first one.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete :{{name}}:?
deleteConfirm.body: It disappears from reactions, and old messages that use it show :{{name}}: instead.

emoji.adminsOnly: On this server, administrators add emoji. Everything in the library is for everyone to use.

games.title: Game activity
games.intro: Show your friends what you are playing, the way the desktop app sees it on this computer.
games.browserOnly: A browser cannot see which programs are running, so game detection works in the Tavvit desktop app. Everything else works here as usual.

detect.label: Detect what I play
detect.description: On until you turn it off. Every 15 seconds Tavvit looks at what is running on this computer: games started from Steam, Epic Games or GOG, and a list of well-known games. Only the game's name is shared, and only while sharing is on under Privacy.

now.title: Detected now
now.none: No game running that Tavvit knows.

games.sharingOff: Sharing your activity is off under Privacy, so friends do not see this.

mine.title: My games
mine.description: You added these yourself earlier. They are still detected until you remove them.

games.updateApp: This version of the Tavvit desktop app cannot detect games yet. Download and install the newest version once; from then on it keeps itself up to date.

device.title: On this device
device.app: The desktop app shows notifications while its window is in the background.
device.granted: Notifications are on. You get one when something is for you and this tab is in the background.
device.default: Notifications are off. Your browser will ask you once.
device.denied: Your browser blocks notifications for this site. Allow them in its site settings, then reload the page.
device.unsupported: This browser does not offer notifications.
device.testBody: This is what a notification looks like.

showText.label: Show the message text
showText.description: Off: a notification only says who wrote, so nobody reads along on your screen.

directMessages.label: Direct messages
directMessages.description: Off: no sound and no notification for direct messages and group chats. They still show as unread.

appBadge.label: Unread count on the app icon

messageSound.label: Sound for new messages
messageSound.description: For a message that would notify you.

callSound.label: Ringtone for calls
callSound.description: Off: an incoming call only shows on screen.

spaces.title: Spaces
spaces.description: How much each space may tell you. This follows your account to your other devices.
spaces.empty: You are not in any space yet.

push.title: Push on this device
push.toggle: Notify me while the app is closed
push.toggleHint: Goes through your browser's push service. It can only read when something arrives, not what it says.
push.installFirst: On an iPhone or iPad this works once Tavvit is on your Home Screen: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, and open it from there.
push.denied: Your browser was told not to show notifications from Tavvit. You can change that in its settings for this site.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: A message with one of these words alerts you like a mention, in channels set to mentions. Only you see them.

sessions.title: Where you are signed in
sessions.description: Every device signed in to this server. If you do not recognise one, sign it out and change your password.

signOutOthersConfirm.title: Sign out everywhere else?
signOutOthersConfirm.description: Every other device is signed out at once, and needs your password to come back.

signOutAllConfirm.title: Sign out everywhere?
signOutAllConfirm.description: Every device is signed out, this one too. You sign in again with your password.

email.title: Email address
email.description: To confirm it is you and to reset a forgotten password. Other people never see it.
email.none: No address yet. Without a confirmed one, only an administrator can reset a forgotten password.
email.pending: Waiting for confirmation: {{address}}. Your current address stays in force until then.
email.waiting: We sent a link to {{address}}. It works for 24 hours. Look in your spam folder too.
email.undeliverable: Mail to this address could not be delivered, so nothing more is sent there. Use another address.
email.sendFailed: The last confirmation mail could not be sent. Try again in a while.

removeConfirm.title: Remove your email address?
removeConfirm.description: Without a confirmed address, only an administrator can reset a forgotten password.

passwordRecovery.confirmed: If you forget your password, we send a link to {{address}}.
passwordRecovery.none: If you forget your password, only an administrator can reset it until you have a confirmed address.
passwordRecovery.noMail: This server does not send email. If you forget your password, only an administrator can reset it.

overview.title: Overview
overview.neverChanged: Not changed since you signed up

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: Signing in also takes a code from an authenticator app such as Aegis, Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password. Someone who gets your password still cannot get in.
twoFactor.off: Off. Signing in takes only your password.
twoFactor.unavailable: Not available on this server: its operator has not set it up.
twoFactor.scan: Scan this with your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
twoFactor.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
twoFactor.manual: Cannot scan? Enter this key in the app:
twoFactor.codeLabel: Code from your app, or a recovery code
twoFactor.codeHint: This account has two-factor authentication on.
twoFactor.codesLow: You are running out of recovery codes. Make new ones while you can still sign in.
twoFactor.disableIntro: Signing in will take only your password again. Enter your password and a code to confirm.
twoFactor.regenerateIntro: Your old recovery codes stop working. Enter your password and a code to confirm.

recovery.intro: Keep these somewhere safe, away from your phone. Each gets you in once if you lose it. They are shown only now.
recovery.saved: I have put them somewhere safe

activity.title: Security activity
activity.description: What happened to this account in the last 90 days.

kinds.login_new_device: Signed in from a new device
kinds.mfa_failed: Wrong code after the right password
kinds.two_factor_reset: Two-factor authentication reset by the operator

developers.title: Bots
developers.description: A bot is a program you run yourself, with an account of its own. You answer for what it does. Up to {{max}}.
developers.disabled: The operator of this instance has not turned bots on.
developers.tokenDescription: Copy it now: it is not shown again. Whoever has it acts as this bot, so treat it like a password.
developers.inviteLabel: Address to bring it into a space
developers.rotateBody: The old token of {{name}} stops working at once, and a running bot is disconnected.
developers.removeBody: {{name}} leaves every space and its token stops working. What it wrote stays.

portal.title: Developer portal
portal.tokenHint: The token is shown once, when it is made. A new one stops the old one at once.
portal.inviteDescription: Whoever opens this address and may manage a space chooses the space and sees what the bot asks for. It can only get rights that person holds, and never administrator.
portal.commandsHint: What your program registered, the last time it told the instance.
portal.noSpaces: It is in no space yet.
